subject: Executive demo request — VP/CIO attendance and compact slot options
messages:
From: Carlos Mendez <carlos.mendez@lobatech.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>
Cc: Ana Ruiz <ana.ruiz@lobatech.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 5 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Exec demo request — CTO/CIO availability?

Hi Priya,

Hope you’re well. We’ve been evaluating inference runtimes and Redwood has come up repeatedly in our architecture reviews. Our CIO (Sanjay Rao) and VP of ML (Ana Ruiz) want a short executive-level walkthrough to understand performance tradeoffs and operational guarantees before we move forward with a pilot.

Ideal ask: 30 minutes compact demo aimed at execs (latency/cost summary + deployment options) followed by a brief Q&A. Prefer the week of Oct 12, but we can be flexible.

Can you share 3 slots where a VP/CIO-friendly compact demo is possible? Also if you have an agenda or 1-pager, send it over so I can confirm with Sanjay.

Attachments: lobatech-requirements.xlsx (XLSX) — brief internal notes on use-cases

Thanks,
Carlos
Carlos Mendez
Director, Infrastructure
Lobatech Inc.
T: +1 415-555-0189
From: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>
To: Carlos Mendez <carlos.mendez@lobatech.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 5 Oct 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Exec demo request — CTO/CIO availability?

Hi Carlos — great to hear from you, and thanks for the context.

We can absolutely run a compact, exec-focused session. Proposed slots (all PDT):
- Tue Oct 13, 11:00–11:45am
- Wed Oct 14, 2:00–2:45pm
- Thu Oct 15, 9:00–9:45am

Agenda (attached): 20 min exec demo (key metrics + deployment pathways), 10 min tradeoffs and high-level cost model, 15 min Q&A. I attached an "executive-demo-agenda.pdf" with bullet points.

Couple quick requests to tailor:
1) Which execs will attend (titles)? you mentioned CIO and VP of ML — any others (CTO/Head of Infra)?
2) Are there specific perf or compliance questions we should prioritize (e.g., multi-region failover, on-prem options, SOC2 evidence)?

We’ll hold the earliest slot tentatively for you and will send a calendar invite once you confirm which time works. If those don't work, we can open an evening slot with one of our VPs.

Best,
Priya Natarajan
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
Attachments: executive-demo-agenda.pdf (PDF)
From: Carlos Mendez <carlos.mendez@lobatech.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>
Cc: Ana Ruiz <ana.ruiz@lobatech.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 7 Oct 2026 08:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Exec demo request — CTO/CIO availability?

Thanks Priya — those windows look good. Sanjay (CIO) can do Wed Oct 14 at 2pm; Ana (VP of ML) will join as well. No one else from execs at this time.

A couple of bullets to prioritize in the demo:
- End-to-end p99 latency for generation at 4k tokens on 8-GPU nodes
- Pricing model for hosted vs private with a sample run-rate for our usage profile (we attached a short usage spreadsheet earlier)
- Security/KMS integration options (we will likely require HSM/KMS for keys in later stages)

Also would appreciate a 1-page follow-up slide summarizing the recommended next steps and a suggested mutual action plan (MAP) we can take to procurement.

If possible, include a 1-slide rough TCO and a short note on fallback policies (auto-failover to a lower-cost model) — that will help get buy-in.

Carlos
